financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Registered public offering of common stock, pre-funded warrants and common warrants, closed Feb 12, 2024 (estimated net proceeds)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: Estimated net proceeds of the Public Offering are approximately $8.0 million, after deducting the Placement Agent fees and estimated offering expenses payable by the Company.

warrants.quote: The Common Warrants have an exercise price of $5.65 per share, are exercisable upon issuance, and will expire five years following the date of issuance.
The Pre-Funded Warrants do not expire and have an exercise price of $0.001 per share.
